name: bench-press-barbell-decline-wide-grip
title: Bench Press: Barbell (Decline, Wide Grip)
primer: This is an exercise for chest, triceps, and shoulder strengthening.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
Place your hands wider than shoulder width apart on the bar and lift it off the rack.
Bring the bar over your chest and lower it until it is just above the lower portion of your chest. This is the starting position.
Extend your arms upward and raise the bar straight up.
Pause for a moment and then lower the bar to the starting position.
